notes.title: Forgettable Dungeon: Update on Current Events
notes.content:
Hey I just wanted to give everyone another update, I keep waiting for good news to share and it just keeps not materializing. 

As some of you may know I got very sick after PAX, with breathing and muscle complications. (I still don't believe this to be Covid-19, just a weird coincidence)

Unfortunately the side effects from this just haven't gotten better. Due to complications from being sick my sleep is now greatly disrupted, and now working from a computer randomly causes my chest to tighten up bringing the breathing issues back.

I was hoping this was just a slipped disc and it'd go away but it's sticking around for far too long.

So with all this progress has been slow.

I am still working on the game as much as I can, however I have to try and keep my health as my main focus.

That's sadly it for now. I hope everyone is taking care of themselves during all the crazy events of the world.

notes.title: Forgettable Dungeon: PAX and Crazyness
notes.content:
Hey everyone wanted to give you a quick update on the games/life current situation.

If you want a more extended writeup of what's been going on, you can read it at the kickstarter page here: 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rotondo/forgettabledungeon/posts/2657363

The tl;dr of things is essentially:[list]
[*] Bought house, no longer homeless!
[*] Bottom floor floods 4" first night we spend in it.
[*] Pay lots of money, remove a little mold, partially remedy problem
[*] Slowly repair/rip out parts of the house.
[*] Try to get back to a somewhat normal dev cycle.
[/list]
	
With this development has slowed the past few months, however I'm hoping it's going to speed up once things calm down a bit.

I'm working on an update though, taking into consideration your feedback. If you have any suggestions or critiques please post in the forums. It really helps.

In more positive news I'm going to be showing the game at PAX East this Friday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10922279/42c748b082cd25228fd7831d2a03f113c7f4ee96.png[/img]

Booth number is 31077, be sure to stop by.

Stay tuned for hopefully more normal game updates in the future.

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon: Spooky Changelog
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

Today I have a special spooky themed update to The Forgettable Dungeon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lMLKiCF.gif[/img]

The summoner will now appear in the graveyard at night conjuring spooky scary skeletons to fight his battles for him.

If you can manage to beat him you may be able to harness his powerful staff to conjure up some mayhem yourself.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tz1nQqB.gif[/img]

There's also a new tree...?

I'd be careful turning your back to this tree at night.

In lighter news fall has hit the forest in the overworld, and even brought along some jack o' lanterns to light your path!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lz26rtb.png[/img]

Beyond these spooky changes I've also fixed a few crash bugs that some people were experiencing thanks to a lot of help from users in the discord.

If you run into any issues, have questions, or just want to say hi be sure to join[url=https://discord.gg/0wDrfggwJYq1yjtF] the discord here[/url].

https://discord.gg/0wDrfggwJYq1yjtF

That's it for now, hope everyone has a nice Halloween!

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon: Changelog r1592
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just wanted to touch base really quick before I post the change log.

I appreciate all the feedback I've been receiving about the game, it's helping me figure out which direction to take certain features.

There's been a few issues that I'm trying to resolve as quickly as I can, some of which are resolved in this patch.

I'm aware that there's a crash glitch that some people have been getting, I'm working hard to try and figure out what the common thread is with this.

If you have experienced the crash or have other feedback please post in the forum or in the discord.

Discord: https://discord.gg/0wDrfggwJYq1yjtF

Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/375810/discussions/

Changelog:
  -- fixed case where you could gain control of the player during the intro cut scene and die
  -- fixed split screen not working properly if game is in full screen mode
  -- fixed case where certain switches wouldn't work with melee / ranged weapons
  -- added more specific message to timeout, to aid in joining LAN servers
  -- fixed animation with exploder enemy
  -- fixed "die once" checklist functionality 
  -- made shopkeepers a less floaty when attacked, and a bit tougher
  -- fixed cyclops health being set to too low

Thanks for taking the time to read this, I hope you've been enjoying the game!

Take care!

Unrelated gif for entertainment purposes:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZPbEOZr.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r1404
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r1404

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hrIsEv7.gif[/img]

Features:
-- Dungeons now have mini bosses scattered around
-- Bombs are now more powerful, limited item, always mapped to a specific button
-- terrain in dungeons is now much more malleable, can be altered via bombs, pickaxe, and hazards 
-- Dungeons now are more varied with each having a different flow
-- The 3 starter dungeons now each have their own alternate theme
-- There are 3 new bosses
-- added .info file option for add-on sprites, you can now edit width, rotate, depthForward, and destroyPercent options in file.
	see example in Add-Ons/modelName.info, requires to be named same as sprite: spriteName.info

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZPbEOZr.gif[/img]
Changes:
-- Ice world is now more unique than other dungeons, surrounded by pits
-- camera is now more dynamic to accommodate destructible environments
-- Shops are now more varied and useful

Bug Fixes:
-- fixed case where you couldn't open steam workshop character in editor
-- when editing workshop files sprites from old version are now correctly selected 
-- fixed case where 3D Guidebook would sometimes rotate out of control when dragged too far 
-- fixed case where jetpack wouldn't work if gold was collected during jetpack 
-- fixed case where falling into a pit immediately at spawn would cause you to fall infinitely

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta -r1226 Overworld overhaul, lock/key doors, ghosts
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r1226

Note: these patch notes are for the past few versions before PAX as well, as those had to be released quickly 

Features:
-- overhauled overworld textures
-- overworld now has detail ridges by floor spaces that meet with water
-- dungeons now have lock/key doors, as well as puzzle doors
-- you can now be revived when killed for a period of time
-- you now become a ghost after being dead for a set period of time 
-- added tooltips to character editor
-- added default set of binds for keyboard controls in rebind menu

Changes:
-- character editor now asks for confirmation for destructive actions
-- character editor now prompts you to save when hitting back
-- stacked yellow enemy now randomly hops in a direction when broken apart 
-- improved bomb explosion effect

Bug fixes:
-- fixed case where you'd be locked inside a room unable to leave
-- fixed edge case where dungeon would generate slightly out of bounds with no valid monsters, allowing chance to be locked in room

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r1194 Performance, combat & dungeon tweaks.
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r1194
Features:
-- greatly increased framerate by splitting the world into more optimal chunks
-- bosses and monsters now push you back as you attack them
-- dungeon paths are now more interesting and varied
-- improved network efficiency when sending strings

Changes:
-- staffs can now be stored in inventory 
-- many textures are now sent in a more optimal way over network
-- blindness potion now blinds more 
-- you no longer bounce off walls when doing a stab attack 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QCwWQho.gif[/img]

Bug fixes:
-- added missing locked ice door
-- fixed some floor tiles not having proper pit walls 
-- fixed case where getting killed by fall damage said you were killed by 0
-- fixed rare case of water rendering overflowing a value, and causing crashing
-- fixed crash where game would render faster than object was cleared, leaving a NULL object that is referenced
-- improved camera shake at higher framerates
-- fixed case where boss key/important items would be destroyed by boulder 
-- fixed map not clearing on dungeon change
-- fixed objects fading into a pit, when in water
-- greatly reduced crashing on exit of game
-- fixed placement of cobwebs
-- fixed direction of spike traps blades in woods
-- transition now works correctly from overworld
-- restructured dungeon path generation to hopefully prevent stuck areas

Note: many textures relating to overworld and dungeons are still placeholder

notes.title: Development update - Puzzles, Ghosts, and Gambling

Thanks for taking the time to read this, take care!

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r1047 Bug fixes, shiny magic items
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r1047

Features:
-- default sword/mace can now be charged and then held for a little while before releasing
-- added highlight to objects that you can pickup/interact with when you're close to them
-- magical items like potions and scrolls now are shiny to make them stand out a bit more
-- finished implementing new cutscene object, no longer tied to specific objects

Changes:
-- staff projectile colors are now the same as their staff 
-- added error message when steam fails to start properly, preventing the game from running

Bug fixes:
-- fixed case where dungeon generator could create isolated areas that you'd get trapped in
-- fixed glyph trap messages not showing correctly 
-- fixed case where charged bow attack wouldn't use energy
-- fixed players floating above half walls, instead of actually colliding with them 
-- fixed particle emitters not transferring over network/splitscreen correctly. fire effects / warp tile effects
-- fixed transition wall details not displaying correctly during level transition 
-- fixed case where taking staffs down stairs would make them not shootable for a period
-- fixed being unable to jump/jetpack sometimes after level change 
-- fixed case where you could pick up the same item and remove it from world 
-- fixed confusion not confusing enough
-- fixed being unable to pick up hardHead ice world enemies 
-- fixed some cases of crashing while exiting/resetting on boss fights
-- fixed skelton john boss shooting right at start of cut scene
-- fixed being unable to throw dead players & idols down ladder
-- fixed shopkeeper not shooting shotgun
-- fixed falling through ice dungeon ice tiles
-- fixed boss cut scenes not sending over network
-- fixed edge case where black dungeon tile would be in a corner, in front of normal dungeon tiles

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r1035 - Network/collision overhaul, Gameplay tweaks, New/tweaked inventory
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r1035

Note: Linux build is not up to date due to not having Linux PC currently.

Features:
-- Implemented new button prompts for interacting & picking up items, now more consistent in informing you of your action ( PC bitmaps are temporary )
-- Implemented new networking and collision for dungeon tile system in preparation for Overworld, faster and less collision issues hopefully
-- added movement item slot for things like feathers, dash boots etc, accessible via B on 360 and SPACE on PC ( Currently no picture in GUI )
-- added ability to put potions and scrolls in and out of pocket by pressing the LB button for 360 controller, or LEFT SHIFT on PC ( Currently no GUI feedback )
-- Implemented new magic ammo/stamina system for all equipable items
-- There's now an outline/shadow of your character when you're behind walls, to aid with visibility
-- added one new potion and staff type 
-- New memory leak... wait this isn't a good feature! Going to be fun to track this one down :(
-- New play area in inn, will contain various items for users to mess with

Changes:
-- staff items are now a new beat em up style item class, while carrying you can't use other weapons/items
-- boomerang is now an item again, has new charge ability
-- One button is now used for picking up, throwing and dropping. Depending on aiming.
-- exploding frog now plays death animation, then starts pulsing to better convey intention
-- staffs now affect all objects in world ( This totally won't break everything... )
-- You will now attack more consistently in the desired direction
-- You now start with no items
-- Monsters will now stay in whichever room they spawned in more often, unless special case 

Bug fixes:
-- fixed case where opening options menu while paused in single player would unpause game
-- hopefully fixed crashing related to overloading of network packet
-- fixed crashing related to skelton john boss fight, involving skull pots
-- fixed case where you'd be unable to move for a time after camera transition
-- fixed case where you could jetpack over doors without activating the room 
-- fixed case where spear traps could be moved by explosions 
-- fixed case where exploding enemy would break if corpse was used as a melee weapon

notes.title: The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - r936 - Woods dungeon / re-structured gameplay
notes.content:
## Patch notes for r936

Features:
-- new woods themed dungeon
-- new snake boss for woods theme
-- 6 new monsters/creatures 
-- re-structured gameplay, you now can choose the order in which you tackle the dungeons

The Forgettable Dungeon Beta - R805
The Forgettable Dungeon - R805
The Forgettable Dungeon - R764
notes.content:
This update features a new world, and a lot of retooled gameplay.

Basic changelist:

-- implemented ice world, which includes new bosses, traps, and enemies
-- monsters now spawn in managed groups of one, two or three, to prevent chaos
-- sped up game over screens
-- player weapon damage is more consistent now, while still being somewhat random
-- removed boss lifebars, not needed as bosses lose pieces as you fight them
-- retooled all hitboxes and hurtboxes, allowing easier dodging and hitting
-- expanded player projectiles hit radius, making it easier to hit targets
-- retooled difficulty
-- replaced emu with snake for dungeon theme
-- secret floors are now handled better, flavor text now appears to warn you
-- colliding with monsters no longer stops your movement
-- added openGamePortSetIP function, allows you to manually enter your pcs external ip.

If you guys want a more detailed changelist I can do that for the next update, I want to keep things somewhat vague as to not spoil new content.

Edit: R765 hot fix

-- fixed cases where dungeon boss & ice boss would sit and take hits without retaliating.
